# AQUA Forte

> Fine Italian dining restaurant in Galle Fort, Sri Lanka, featuring authentic regional cuisine, premium wines, and signature dishes by Chef Roberto.

AQUA Forte is a premier Italian restaurant located in the historic Galle Fort, Sri Lanka, offering authentic Italian cuisine crafted with imported ingredients from regions like Gragnano and Modena. The restaurant also operates AQUA Forno, an Italian bakery, and is part of the AQUA restaurant family including AQUA Pazza.
